display.purpose: Two-line Home name using the locally bundled Plus Jakarta Sans family.

body.purpose: Base interface text and inherited local font family.

label.purpose: Small section headings; selected work has its own local title declaration.

shadows.name: control-light
shadows.purpose: Shared painted controls in light mode; live CSS token --shadow-control.

shadows.name: card-light
shadows.purpose: Interactive neutral cards and sketch previews in light mode; live CSS token --shadow-card.

motion.name: project-title-ease
motion.purpose: Title, state feedback and Home reveal easing.

motion.name: home-scroll-reveal
motion.purpose: Once-only Home reveals rise by 24px. Keyboard, restored reading and preferences reveal content immediately.

motion.name: magnetic-spring
motion.purpose: MAGNET_SPRING in app/lib/interaction-motion.ts, shared by stationary native targets with moving children.

motion.name: magnetic-limits
motion.purpose: Maximum displacement per axis in PointerEnhancements.

motion.name: control-spring
motion.purpose: CONTROL_SPRING for painted native buttons and the About deck.

motion.name: control-press
motion.purpose: Painted child only; reset or suppress on keyboard focus, disabled state, cancellation, preferences, blur and hidden document.

motion.name: trivia-answer-slide
motion.purpose: Vertical trivia answer faces and opacity in a content-sized grid; zero duration for keyboard/reduced motion/forced colors.

motion.name: notebook-back-rotation
motion.purpose: Soft blue inactive layers behind the neutral front card; 1deg and -1.5deg below an 18rem text-relative container width. Stable preference modes hide back cards.

motion.name: trivia-pickup
motion.purpose: The whole active card lifts during free dragging on both axes, within viewport bounds, then returns with the shared spring. Keyboard and motion preferences stay stationary. Viewport changes cancel held input before or after drag start and reset the card immediately; oversized cards use native scrolling.

motion.name: theme-thumb
motion.purpose: 36px circular cobalt thumb in an 88px by 48px native switch track.

motion.name: footer-arrow-press
motion.value: scale(.97); press 120ms; release 160ms; reduced-motion opacity .85 over 80ms
motion.purpose: Existing local native footer-link feedback, distinct from ControlVisual.

motion.name: trivia-answer-height
motion.purpose: Only the active visible face determines height. A single active ResizeObserver reacts to content and font/viewport changes; keyboard and motion preferences settle immediately. Equal rounded heights are skipped.

breakpoints.name: horizontal-media
breakpoints.purpose: Also requires normal motion, no forced colors, observation and complete measured content fit.

breakpoints.name: menu-label-reflow
breakpoints.purpose: Places the index and arrow above a full-width label when enlarged text needs more room.

breakpoints.name: about-reading-reflow
breakpoints.purpose: Stacks What I do/Experience, Learning/comparison and trivia when text-relative reading width is insufficient; restored section padding remains unchanged.

components.html:
Skip to implementation considerations
02 Customer records

Keep actions with the record

A searchable table keeps status and actions together. The customer form opens over the list without losing context.

The client presentation documents the design. A live product, working prototype and measured business results are not available.

Design and build notes

A build would need validated inputs, accurate invoice previews, draft recovery and clear failure feedback.

components.name: Little trivia card
components.description: Whole-card free dragging paints beyond the deck with viewport bounds, 1.015 pickup and the shared spring return. Sideways swipes change questions; vertical releases return the same card. Native answer/next controls, cancellation, inert inactive cards and motion preferences remain usable. Three local discovery dots mark revealed stories. The 460px deck sizes from the active card and visible face; answer height adapts over 220ms. An 8px inset retains mobile drag clearance. Held input cancels on viewport changes, with an immediate return to the new layout. When the active card exceeds available viewport height, native scrolling takes priority while reveal/next remain usable. Size observers skip identical heights and update fit state only when it changes.

narrative.overview: The implemented portfolio uses Plus Jakarta Sans, warm off-white, charcoal, exact cobalt, generous gutters, thin dividers, and the original AS mark. Home uses Alan's voxel character; About retains the real portrait. Original interface screens provide case-study evidence. PRODUCT.md owns product commitments; DESIGN.md owns shared visual rules; docs/README.md maps current behavior and provenance. About presents capabilities, experience, the Static / Motion learning comparison, then compact trivia. Reading stays flat while interactive cards and painted controls use raised neutral and blue supporting layers.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white and charcoal with cobalt for identity and actions.
Large name typography, compact project titles, generous gutters and thin rules.
A voxel Home character, a real About portrait and original case-study screenshots.
Native links, visible focus and complete static fallbacks for enhanced interactions.
Neutral raised interactive cards and cobalt painted actions with soft blue supporting states.

rules.name: The Accent Rule
rules.body: Keep cobalt unchanged in both themes for established identity details and filled actions. Use action-ink for small action text and icons; preserve the original AS mark's supplied blue shading.

rules.name: The Cobalt Support Rule
rules.body: Keep the page canvas neutral. Use soft blue for supporting interactive layers and states; do not spread the prototype's pastel palette across reading sections.

rules.name: The Font Delivery Rule
rules.body: Preserve the bundled Plus Jakarta Sans family and verify actual font loading and wrapping after typography changes.

rules.name: The Reading and Interaction Rule
rules.body: Keep reading sections and original case evidence flat and square. Apply shared depth to interactive cards and painted controls, including their supporting blue layers.

dos: Do preserve Plus Jakarta Sans, the warm canvas, charcoal/cobalt identity and supplied AS mark.
Do use the voxel character on Home and retain the real portrait on About with their provenance.
Do keep visible keyboard focus, native links and complete static content when enhancements stop.
Do keep original case images and full-source access beside display crops.
Do keep Contact drafts editable and available after copy or email-app failure.
Do label every resume control Download resume with a PDF cue.
Do use the shared neutral, soft blue, radius and shadow tokens for interactive cards and painted controls.
Do keep the native target still while magnetic and press feedback move its child artwork.
donts: Don't restore the removed Design • Engineer phrase or practice tracks as current requirements.
Don't turn component-local role colors, image backing or responsive exceptions into global tokens.
Don't spread lavender, mint or peach prototype colors across the portfolio or box ordinary reading sections into interactive cards.
Don't treat generated gallery artwork as original case-study evidence or enlarge low-resolution details as a claim of recovered information.
Don't invent project outcomes, Munchpal sponsors/partners or an academic origin.
Don't claim a pixel match to the missing composition image, physical-device coverage or a complete release from this documentation pass.
